## Fixes
- **The browser no longer fills your saved address into Settings.** The username, password and URL fields under ⚙ Settings (qBittorrent, NZBGet, Nginx Proxy Manager, ArrHub login, service URLs) had no proper `autocomplete` hints, so Chrome/Edge guessed they were address fields and offered or filled a saved address. Every field now says what it is: usernames are marked as usernames for their own service, passwords and API keys as `new-password` (the browser no longer fills your ArrHub password into qBittorrent or API key fields), and URL fields are excluded from autofill.
